title: Actor spawning burst in single frame
fix_rationale: The trace shows actor spawning and initialization taking substantial GameThread time. Spreading spawns across multiple frames or reusing pre-spawned actors via object pooling eliminates the spike.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess frame time) executing actor spawning and initialization logic.

fixes.text: Implement an Actor Pool for frequently spawned gameplay entities (projectiles, effects, enemies).
Stagger multi-actor spawning across several frames using a spawn queue or timer.
Simplify Blueprint Construction Scripts and defer heavy initialization until after spawn.

verify: Re-test the spawn event and verify that spawning duration stays within frame budget.
